_comment: The shared encoder, pinned. `revision` is a Hugging Face commit sha, not
a tag: a tag can move, and a moved encoder silently invalidates every
calibrated band in every semantic-config.json built against it.
`files[].sha256` is verified against the bytes actually fetched by
scripts/fetch-model.mjs, so a mirror serving different weights fails the
fetch instead of quietly shifting cosines by a few thousandths.
Nothing here is fetched at request time. fetch-model.mjs runs at install
or build time; the runtime sets allowRemoteModels=false, so a missing
cache is a startup error, never a network call inside a request.
Same encoder family as Ereno sigma (multilingual-e5-small, int8/q8 ONNX),
on purpose: centroid sets built on one platform stay meaningful on the
other. See README, 'Relationship to Ereno sigma'.
